name: MiniMax H3 Image
note: [MiniMax H3 Image](https://huggingface.co/MiniMaxAI/MiniMax-H3-Image) generates and edits images of about 16 megapixels at every aspect ratio, from 4096×4096 to 6272×2688, without an upscaler. Provide up to 16 reference images through the canvas and moodboard, and identify them in the prompt as <Picture 1>, <Picture 2>, etc., or omit images for text-to-image. It expects a detailed English description of the whole image. The model is distilled to 6 steps without guidance: start with 4096×4096, 6 DDIM Trailing steps, Text Guidance 1, and Shift 3 with resolution-dependent shift disabled.
